description: A worker's payment waits for the owner; the approval request names the principal, the tool, the scope and the digest of the exact arguments to sign for.
A signed owner approval bound to this rule, rulebook, principal, participant, tool, scope and argument digest, unused and inside its window, clears the wait: ALLOW with approvalsUsed.
RULING 2: the same approval presented for amount 1200 — the digest differs — grants nothing: PAUSE, approvalsRejected code "args", a fresh approval request.
An approval validly signed for amount 1200 does not clear a call for 120: code "args". Approving one amount never approves another.
RULING 1: an expired approval is rejected (code "expired"), the wait stays PAUSE; it is never a BLOCK.
An approval issued after now: code "not_yet_valid".
An approval whose nonce the caller already consumed: code "replayed".
An approval for another rule: code "rule".
An approval given for another principal: code "principal".
An approval for another participant: code "participant".
An approval for another tool: code "tool".
An approval for another scope: code "scope".
An approval given under another rulebook fingerprint: code "rulebook".
A valid approval signed by a key trusted for the agent authority cannot satisfy a wait for the owner: code "insufficient".
The pure evaluator, given the signed approval as request data, clears nothing: code "unverified" (verify first, or use verifyAndEvaluate).
A robot-domain-rules-approval/3 approval (bound to an action and an area) at a /1 rulebook is rejected by spec, never reinterpreted: code "spec".
A decision names a rejected approval by id, nonce and code only: the decision JSON contains no "signature", "publicKey" or "keyId" anywhere.
Repeated refusals are the harness's to record and a rule's to judge: with three approval_refused entries in the last hour, cool_off denies the payment outright.
With two refusals the rule does not match and the payment still waits.
A neuroverse-governance-approval/1 approval at a /3 rulebook is refused by spec (the /3 door does not reinterpret it): PAUSE, the wait stays.
A /1 approval signed by a trusted key verifies (TEST ONLY seeds: owner 55…55, agent 66…66).
A flipped signature does not verify.
A /1 approval without argsDigest is incomplete and does not verify.
A key trusted for the agent authority cannot sign as the owner.

expect.note: key "test-agent" is not trusted to approve as authority "owner"
